Promptfoo 0.123.0 uses the Responses API by default for GPT-5.6 and newer models. This is indicated by the breaking changes mentioned in the release notes, specifically under the section that states the default behavior for these models.

From the context provided:

- The release notes in [6] mention a breaking change: "default GPT-5.6+ to Responses" ([#10803](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10803)).
- The documentation in [4] reinforces this by stating: "For GPT-5.6 and newer models, use `openai:<model>`, such as `openai:gpt-6-luna`. These IDs default to Responses."

Therefore, the default API used is the Responses API. 

References:
- "default GPT-5.6+ to Responses." [promptfoo/0.123.0.md](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.122.2...0.123.0) (2026-09-10) [6]
- "For GPT-5.6 and newer models, use `openai:<model>`, such as `openai:gpt-6-luna`. These IDs default to Responses." [promptfoo/site/docs/providers/openai.md](example/guide.md) [4]
